referenceGrid.purpose: visual benchmark for transferable composition grammar; never a coordinate or content template

reference.purpose: single-image visual reference for the connected-dataflow family

l0Fixture.purpose: renderer and editable document expressiveness only; not evidence of AI generation quality

requiredVisuals: secondary ingestion or asynchronous pipeline is visually grouped
store and processing roles use distinct semantic shapes or colors
cross-region and feedback relationships have separate routes
boundary contains its members with visible title
external participant and boundary crossing are unambiguous
normal, callback, and failure/status routes remain distinguishable
service roles remain legible at overview scale
radial labels avoid ring and node collisions
inner and outer participants remain visually distinct
directional relationships and outcomes remain traceable
multiple editable primitives compose a recognizable whole
rotation, proportion, stroke and fill are coherent
decorative elements do not become graph edges or routing obstacles

visualRequirements: select a composition grammar from content rather than a keyword template
use consistent hierarchy, semantic styling, readable text and deliberate whitespace
keep containers, rings, decorative primitives and labels editable
route relationships around unrelated objects and distinguish relationship types
return a real rendered inspection and apply bounded, local repairs
never copy official demo coordinates, text, object arrays or fixed colors as production output
forbiddenShortcuts: fixed official-demo coordinates or node IDs
flattened screenshot or single SVG replacing editable objects
manual engineering edits after product AI generation
declaring quality from structural checks without rendered inspection
